claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_environmental_temperature_immunity
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item has a second passive effect that prevents harm from sub-zero ambient temperatures for the wearer and carried gear. The current surface covers combat damage reduction, but it has no atom for deterministic environmental temperature protection.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: while wearing this ring, you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower
